Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas, when my car met the rear bumper of a
pickup that was rolling slowly through the aisle. The impact was not severe, but my head snapped forward and then
back, and I felt a sharp pain in my neck and upper shoulders within minutes. I gave the same description to the other
driver, to the responding officer, and later to the adjuster and the medical staff: I checked my mirrors, I was moving at
walking pace, and I did not see the pickup until the contact. I live in the same household as the policyholder and I was
driving the insured vehicle with permission, which I understand makes me a covered household member under this
policy. I have been seeing a physical therapist for the stiffness and headaches since the collision and I am following
the treatment plan I was given.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
